6.2.basis: escalation clause: 12 distinct verified half-point measures

7.1.basis: Malaysia has a dedicated horizontal statute, the Personal Data Protection Act 2010, providing a general legal framework for personal data protection. The existence of s.2(2) as a scoping provision within this Act indicates a comprehensive, cross-sectoral law rather than a mere sectoral or absent framework.

7.2.basis: The evidence row shows Malaysia has enacted a dedicated horizontal Cyber Security Act 2024, with s.4 establishing its general application/framework scope. Rejected candidates (s.26, s.18(2), Licensing Regulations) confirm ancillary provisions (licensing, coordination, disclosure) exist within this same comprehensive Act, not that the framework itself is absent or merely sectoral. Since a dedicated economy-level cybersecurity law exists, the inverted indicator (lack of framework) scores 0.
